title: Pure Materiactor
summary: Materiactor cards with generic Rank 3 Xyz Monsters and staples; the page's Speedroid, Phantom Knights, Armored Xyz and Fiendsmith partners are left out. The engine runs on Level 3 Normal Monsters, and Prima Materiactor, the newest card, is the archetype's own: Exareptor searches it and summons itself, Gigadra and Zeptwing put it on the field, and as a Scale it attaches itself to a Materiactor Xyz to draw. Two Level 3s make Materiactor Exagard, which summons Zeptwing from the Deck and returns materials to the hand when the opponent summons. Materiactor Meltthrough, the 2025 Field Spell, makes a Materiactor Xyz from a single Level 3 Normal for 1500 LP. Materiactor Critical negates by returning one of those materials to the hand. Gigadra and Meltthrough lock the Extra Deck to Xyz, so the Extra Deck is all Rank 3.
